changes.title: Lower and project host plugins
changes.summary: The `@capability` and `@agent-profile` words gain an invocation section and `@distribution` a product section; ia init --from lowers a Claude, Codex or Grok plugin into a kit workspace; ia project --product plugin renders it back and --check proves the round trip.

changes.title: Opt-in native conformance evidence for COMP-KERNEL and COMP-FIXTURES
changes.summary: Compliance C31. @inventarch/compliance adds verifyKernel(floor?) and verifyFixtures(), isConformanceEvidence(value, subject?), CONFORMANCE_PROFILE ('package-v1') and the KernelEvidence, FixtureEvidence, ConformanceEvidence, ConformanceToolchain, ConformanceProfile, OutOfProfileSuite, KernelSource, ConformanceOptions and ConformanceSummary types. verifyKernel regenerates the kernel from a floor (the embedded one by default) in-process and compares it with the running @inventarch/language; verifyFixtures runs the package-v1 profile of the shipped language, refusal and evidence fixtures against a generated inventory. Both run only when called and read only this package's own files. Their evidence is deeply frozen and accepted only from the producing module instance. evaluate's new opt-in conformance: {inputs, kernel, fixtures} option binds that evidence to the evaluated graph: evidence for another revision, language version, kernel digest, floor or toolchain stays not-evaluated, each check judged on its own evidence, a verified failure on the graph's own floor fails, and copied, hand-built or swapped evidence, or evidence together with conformance, is a TypeError. evaluate reads the inputs once and refuses fields that are not strings. Results verified from evaluated evidence carry the new Verdict.basis 'verified' and add Report.conformance for those checks, a verified fixture result with the suites it did not run. Results taken from the caller-asserted evidence map now carry basis 'caller-asserted' and are rebuilt from their check, scope, outcome and findings, so other keys a caller put on such a verdict no longer reach the report: outcomes are unchanged, but reports from callers that pass the map change digest. Reports that pass neither option are unchanged. Limits: the profile does not run the hook, runtime, execution or publication suites, and every fixture result lists them as out of profile; the evidence verifies the installed package against itself, and the binding trusts the Graph it is given, so a consumer pins kernelDigest and inventoryDigest and relies on npm integrity.

changes.title: Cite the predecessor repository's issues by name
changes.summary: Comments, SPEC text and test titles that cited issues and pull requests of the predecessor repository by bare number now cite them as crowncodes/ia#N, so they no longer resolve to unrelated items in this repository. Comments, documentation and test titles only; no behaviour, export, output or dependency changes.

changes.title: Refresh the package READMEs for 3.1
changes.summary: Each package README now has a badge row, a short summary, a verified quick start or example, its main commands or exports, its limits and links, in the voice of the repository README. The CLI README is the 3.x command guide: preview and author, mandate checks and --actor, the removal of ia compile, Claude Code and Codex as the supported hosts, and the 3.1 host plugin commands ia init --from and ia project --product plugin. The compliance README shows the opt-in conformance evidence and the workspace-runtime README the host plugin subpaths. Documentation only; no package behaviour, export or dependency changes.

changes.title: Self-contained phase rows in generated position packets
changes.summary: The position packet that `ia project` and `ia host` write (`.claude/rules/ia-workspace.md` for Claude Code, `AGENTS.md` for Codex) no longer cites a decision record outside this repository. Each phase row now reads `--phase selects the playbook cell delivered and decides which conditional relation rows apply`. The packet text and its digest change, so `ia doctor` reports a projection an earlier version wrote as outdated until `ia project <host> --apply` writes it again. Nothing else in the packet, the position body or the delivery view changes.

changes.title: Cite public sources in package contracts and comments
changes.summary: Package SPECs, source comments and test titles state each rule, or cite the public SPEC clause or docs/specs section that states it, instead of planning milestones, tasks, amendments, design rows, review-finding ids and decision names that live outside this repository. Comments, documentation and test titles only; no behaviour, export, output or dependency changes.

changes.title: Cite public contracts in package sources
changes.summary: Package contracts, source comments and tests cite the public SPEC clauses that state each rule instead of planning documents kept outside this repository. No behaviour, export or dependency changes.
